name: A1-cursor-queue
prompt: A dramatic still life that reads instantly at thumbnail size. Subject: a polished vintage brass cash register on a dark counter, its cash drawer sprung open and completely empty. Action: in front of it, a long orderly queue of oversized white computer arrow cursors, each the size of a person's hand, stands in single file stretching back into the darkness as if waiting to pay, but none of them is buying. Context: a moody near-black shop interior. Composition: low three-quarter angle, register sharp in the foreground right, the cursor queue receding diagonally to the left with shallow depth of field. Lighting: a single warm gold spotlight from above on the empty drawer, cool rim light on the cursors, deep shadows everywhere else. Style: cinematic surreal product photography, Sony A7R IV 50mm f/2, rich blacks with gold highlights, high contrast. No text, no words, no logos, no numbers anywhere in the image.

name: A2-bill-magnet
prompt: A surreal miniature scene that reads at thumbnail size. Subject: one crisp US banknote folded into the shape of a horseshoe magnet, standing upright on a dark slate tabletop. Action: dozens of tiny tilt-shift miniature people, shoppers with bags, are being pulled toward the magnet in streams from every direction, some sliding, some running, clearly drawn in by an invisible force. Context: an otherwise empty black tabletop like a stage. Composition: slightly high angle, magnet centered, the crowds converging on it in curved lines that lead the eye to the center. Lighting: warm gold key light on the folded bill, soft falloff into darkness, subtle gold motion streaks behind the tiny figures. Style: macro tilt-shift miniature photography, rich blacks, gold accents, high contrast, playful and clever. No readable text or numbers anywhere; the banknote's printing is soft and illegible.

name: A3-expired-phone
prompt: A witty, slightly unsettling still life that reads at thumbnail size. Subject: a modern smartphone shrink-wrapped on a black supermarket foam tray exactly like a cut of meat, with plastic film stretched tight and a few condensation droplets on it. On the film sits a bright blank yellow reduced-price sticker with no writing on it. Action: the phone screen shows a faded, washed-out, greyed colorful ad layout, visibly past its best, slightly desaturated. Context: a dark refrigerated supermarket shelf, cold blue air. Composition: top-down flat lay, tray centered with generous dark negative space around it. Lighting: cold blue fridge light from above with one warm gold highlight catching the sticker edge. Style: commercial food photography, ultra-sharp detail, high contrast, near-black background. The sticker is completely blank. No text, no words, no numbers, no logos anywhere.

name: A4-gold-phone
prompt: A bold pattern-interrupt image that reads at thumbnail size. Subject: a tight grid of identical matte grey smartphones lying face up on a black surface, five across and five down, every screen showing the same dull grey placeholder ad layout. Action: the single phone in the exact center is different: its screen blazes with warm gold light and a vivid, colorful, eye-catching image, glowing so brightly it lights up the edges of the grey phones around it. Context: a dark minimalist studio surface. Composition: straight top-down flat lay, perfectly regimented grid, the gold phone dead center as the obvious focal point. Lighting: dim cool light on the grey phones, intense warm gold glow emanating from the center phone. Style: clean commercial product photography, crisp, high contrast, near-black and grey with a single gold accent. No readable text, no words, no logos, no numbers on any screen.

name: A5-sledgehammer
prompt: A dramatic cinematic still life that reads at thumbnail size. Subject: an old, scratched smartphone lying face up on a dark concrete floor, its screen shattered into a spider web of cracks. Action: a heavy sledgehammer rests across it at an angle, just after the blow, and brilliant warm gold light pours up and out through the cracks in the screen as if something far better is underneath, with a few fine shards and gold dust suspended in the air. Context: a dark industrial space. Composition: low angle close-up, phone in the lower third, the hammer handle leading diagonally out of frame, the gold light the brightest point in the image. Lighting: the gold glow from the cracks as the key light, faint cool rim light on the hammer head, deep shadows. Style: high-speed cinematic photography, Sony A7R IV 35mm, high contrast, rich blacks and gold. No text, no words, no logos, no numbers anywhere.

name: B1-pen-coins
prompt: An elegant visual metaphor that reads at thumbnail size. Subject: a classic black and gold fountain pen held at a writing angle over a sheet of thick cream paper on a dark walnut desk. Action: the line of ink flowing from the nib curves across the page and partway along transforms into a stream of shining gold coins that spill off the edge of the paper and tumble onto the desk. Context: a quiet, dark study at night. Composition: close-up three-quarter angle, the nib sharp in focus, the coin stream leading the eye from the pen to the pile, shallow depth of field. Lighting: a warm gold desk-lamp key light from the left, soft shadows, coins catching bright specular highlights. Style: luxury editorial photography, 85mm macro, rich warm tones, near-black background, high contrast. The paper shows only an abstract ink line, no readable words, no letters, no numbers, no logos anywhere.

name: B2-footprints
prompt: A quiet, haunting image that tells a story at thumbnail size. Subject: the doorway of a small, beautifully lit independent shop, its glass door propped wide open. Action: on the pale stone floor just inside, a dense trail of dusty footprints walks in through the door, takes two or three steps, then every single set turns around and walks straight back out again. The shop beyond is warm, stocked and completely empty of people. Context: dusk, dark street outside, the shop interior glowing gold. Composition: high angle looking down at the threshold so the footprint pattern reads clearly as in-and-out, the warm empty shop in soft focus behind. Lighting: warm gold interior light spilling onto the floor, cool blue dusk outside, strong contrast between the two. Style: cinematic documentary photography, 35mm, rich shadows, gold and deep blue palette. No signage, no readable text, no words, no logos, no numbers anywhere.

name: B4-gift-doorstep
prompt: A poignant curiosity image that reads at thumbnail size. Subject: a beautiful, premium gift box wrapped in deep black paper and tied with a lush gold satin ribbon and bow, clearly something valuable. Action: it sits unopened and ignored on a dark front doorstep; a fine cobweb stretches from the bow to the door frame and a few fallen autumn leaves have gathered against it, showing it has been there a long time. Context: a dark wooden front door, evening, nobody around. Composition: eye-level medium close-up, the box centered on the step with the closed door behind, shallow depth of field. Lighting: a single warm porch light from above making the gold ribbon glow, the rest falling into deep shadow. Style: cinematic still life photography, 50mm f/1.8, high contrast, rich blacks and gold, slightly melancholic. No gift tag text, no words, no logos, no numbers anywhere.

name: B5-pen-lever
prompt: A clever physics-metaphor image that reads at thumbnail size. Subject: an ordinary slim black ballpoint pen used as a lever, balanced across a small gold cube that acts as the fulcrum on a dark desk. Action: a single fingertip presses lightly down on one end of the pen, and the other end effortlessly lifts a tall, heavy stack of banded US banknotes clear off the desk surface, the stack visibly rising. Context: a dark, minimalist executive desk. Composition: side-on eye-level view, the lever line running across the frame, the rising cash stack on the right as the payoff, generous negative space above. Lighting: warm gold spotlight on the cash and fulcrum, soft cool fill, deep black background. Style: crisp conceptual commercial photography, 85mm, high contrast, gold and black palette. Banknote printing soft and illegible. No readable text, no words, no logos, no numbers anywhere.
